import sys, re
from collections import Counter

data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode('latin-1')
nl = data.find('\n')
first = data if nl < 0 else data[:nl]
rest = '' if nl < 0 else data[nl + 1:]
try:
    k = int(first.strip())
except ValueError:
    k = 0
c = Counter(w.lower() for w in re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9]+', rest))
items = sorted(c.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
out = [f"{w} {n}" for w, n in items[:max(k, 0)]]
if out:
    print("\n".join(out))
